scope: Executable review-evidence portability; no candidate, source-pool, accepted-ledger or public artifact changes.
findings: Six executable checks loaded a hardcoded coordinator checkout. They now resolve their own repository ledger and trust code.

Chemistry historical first-pass verification unconditionally loaded a private PDF. It now reuses the existing pinned source-material gate: missing PDF allowed only for integrated replay; present wrong PDF and pre-intake missing PDF remain failures. Explicit --pool and --pdf paths support immutable historical fixtures and source verification.
No git-show or unpushed-commit execution dependency was found in the inspected review checkers and JAMB tests/scripts.
Other inspected source-PDF checks already permit absence during integrated replay and retain the PDF requirement before intake. Their optional local source paths were not changed.
Draft browser screenshot utilities and inventory/preparation scripts remain outside this release-evidence audit.

validation.temporary_checkout_without_git_or_privat: Literature replay passes from a minimal temporary checkout. Deleting or corrupting its accepted ledger entry, changing review status, or rejecting in its local trust module fails without falling back to the coordinator.
validation.chemistry_historical_fixture: All 850 original IDs are reconstructed explicitly into the historical first-pass state. Integrated replay passes without PDF; pre-intake missing PDF, present wrong PDF and pool mutation fail.

known_limitation: Chemistry check-first-pass.cjs remains a strict historical first-pass checker, not a cumulative recovery checker. On the current recovered bank it correctly stops at chemistry-1983-13-226552c20011 because that historical held row has since been replaced. This pre-existing failure was reproduced before changes; no held-state guard was weakened. Use the cumulative recovery evidence for current-bank recovery validation or the explicit historical fixture for first-pass replay.
not_run: Full build, browser UI and deploy/security stack: executable private checker-only change; no public route or artifact changed.
